subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should maintainers adopt this iOS preview-tour first-run experience on top of the current onboarding refresh, narrow it to selected preview pieces, or close it in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: the branch adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, saved-Gateway routing preservation, and fresh route proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview pieces
options.body: Extract only the sample preview surfaces maintainers still want and leave connection-path behavior to the current onboarding baseline and focused onboarding PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer wanted.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, saved-Gateway routing preservation, and fresh route proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh authored the newest merged mobile onboarding and typography refresh that this PR must reconcile with.
